name: TeamStarWolf - Iran-Attributed Threat Actors Case Study
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. The 260 Enterprise techniques that ATT&CK v20.0 links to 19 Iran-attributed groups, plus those named in eight joint advisories (AA20-259A, AA21-321A, AA22-055A, AA22-257A, AA22-320A, AA23-335A, AA24-241A, AA24-290A), bound in case-studies/THREAT_ACTORS_IRAN.md. Score = number of Iran-attributed groups plus number of advisories that name the technique (a count of public reporting, not prevalence or severity). Revoked advisory ids are shown under their v20 successors per data/attack/superseded_by.jsonl. Each comment names the groups and the study source numbers.

legendItems.label: Score = Iran-attributed ATT&CK groups + joint advisories naming the technique

metadata.name: score_meaning
metadata.value: Groups plus advisories naming the technique; no severity, prevalence, or coverage is measured.

metadata.name: tactic_policy
metadata.value: Each selected technique is shown under all tactics it has in the library's technique profiles. This is display expansion, not a claim that every tactic applies to the procedure.

metadata.name: attack_version
metadata.value: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise v20.0: technique IDs and tactics normalized to data/attack/technique_profiles.jsonl by scripts/build_navigator_layers.py
